newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Surya Semesta to list 20 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Surya Semesta to list 20 pct stake.

text.p: Indonesian property firm PT Surya Semesta Internusa said on Wednesday it planned to list a 20-percent stake later this year.
"The firm expects to list its shares later this year either on the Surabaya or Jakarta stock exchanges or both," a company official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
She said the firm expected to list a 20-percent stake, or 135 million shares, with a nominal value of 500 rupiah each.
It expected to appoint brokerage firms PT Usaha Bersama Sekuritas as lead underwriter and PT Prime East Indonesia as lead international placement agent, she added.
She said the firm planned to a hold a public presentation later in February to disseminate more information on the firm.
She declined to give further details.
